shipping-policy: Last Updated: August 2026 At KREAN JEWELS , we believe that every order deserves the same level of care and precision as the jewelry itself. From the moment your order is placed until it arrives at your doorstep, we are committed to providing a secure, reliable, and seamless shipping experience. Every piece is meticulously handcrafted, carefully inspected through our quality assurance process, professionally packaged, and securely protected for transit. We partner with trusted global courier services and provide full shipment tracking and insurance to help ensure your jewelry arrives safely, securely, and in pristine condition. Our commitment to excellence extends beyond exceptional craftsmanship—we strive to deliver every order with the highest standards of care, security, and attention to detail, giving you complete confidence and peace of mind throughout your shopping experience with KREAN JEWELS . Order Processing At KREAN JEWELS , every order is carefully reviewed, prepared, and inspected through our comprehensive quality assurance process before shipment. Standard orders are typically processed within 3–5 business days after successful payment verification. Custom-designed, personalized, made-to-order, or high-value jewelry may require additional production and quality inspection time to ensure every piece meets our exceptional craftsmanship and quality standards. Estimated production timelines will be provided during the ordering process and may vary depending on the complexity of the design, customization requirements, and materials selected. Once your order has been completed and dispatched, you will receive a Shipping Confirmation Email containing your tracking information, allowing you to monitor your shipment every step of the way. Business Days & Cut-Off Time To maintain the highest standards of quality and customer service, KREAN JEWELS processes orders Monday through Friday , excluding weekends (Saturday & Sunday) and U.S. public holidays . Order Processing Days: Monday – Friday Daily Cut-Off Time: 4:00 PM Eastern Time (ET) Orders placed before 4:00 PM (ET) on a business day will enter processing as soon as payment verification is completed. Orders placed after the daily cut-off time , on weekends, or during U.S. public holidays will begin processing on the next available business day . Please note that order processing times are separate from shipping transit times. The estimated delivery timeframe begins only after your order has been processed, completed, and handed over to the shipping carrier. Shipping Services Trusted Shipping Partners At KREAN JEWELS , we partner with some of the world's most trusted courier companies to provide a secure, reliable, and seamless delivery experience for every order. Our primary shipping partners include: FedEx DHL Express UPS USPS (United States only) If one of these carriers is unavailable for your delivery location, we may utilize another approved, fully insured international courier service that offers comparable reliability, security, and shipment tracking. Every order is professionally prepared, carefully packaged, and fully insured throughout transit to protect your purchase until it is safely delivered. We automatically select the most appropriate shipping carrier based on your delivery address, destination country, package size and weight, order value, customs requirements, carrier availability, and estimated delivery time. This allows us to provide the safest, fastest, and most dependable shipping experience possible. Once your order has been dispatched, you will receive a Shipping Confirmation Email containing your shipment tracking information, enabling you to monitor your package in real time from dispatch through final delivery. Important: The shipping carriers and services listed in this policy are not customer-selectable . KREAN JEWELS determines the most suitable shipping method for each order to optimize delivery speed, security, customs clearance, and overall shipping reliability. Important Shipping Information Shipping availability, delivery methods, estimated delivery times, duties, taxes, and shipping charges may vary by destination. Certain remote areas, territories, or destinations may have limited service or additional delivery restrictions. KREAN JEWELS reserves the right to restrict shipping to specific destinations when required by carrier limitations, customs regulations, sanctions, or applicable laws. Estimated Delivery Times The delivery timeframes below are estimates and may vary depending on customs clearance, local courier operations, weather conditions, or other unforeseen circumstances. United States Standard Delivery: 11–18 Business Days Express Delivery: 9–13 Business Days South Korea Express Delivery: 11–18 Business Days International Destinations Standard International Delivery: 11–21 Business Days Economy International Delivery: 7–18 Business Days Express International Delivery: 7–12 Business Days Please Note: Delivery estimates begin once your order has been " Processed" and " Dispatched" . Custom-made or made-to-order jewelry may require " additional" production time before shipping. Orders shipped with DDP (Delivered Duty Paid) include prepaid import duties and taxes where available, so no additional customs charges are due upon delivery. During checkout, you will be able to see whether your selected shipping method includes DDP (Delivered Duty Paid) or not before completing your purchase. Estimated Delivery Time Estimated delivery timeframes begin only after your order has been successfully processed, payment has been verified, and any required production, customization, or quality inspections have been completed . Processing and production times are separate from shipping transit times. While KREAN JEWELS works closely with trusted global shipping partners to deliver every order as quickly and securely as possible, actual delivery times may vary depending on factors beyond our reasonable control. These may include the destination country, customs clearance procedures, import regulations, carrier operations, adverse weather conditions, transportation disruptions, public holidays, remote delivery locations, and periods of high shipping demand. All delivery timeframes provided on our website are estimated and are intended as general guidelines only. Although we make every reasonable effort to meet these estimates, they are not guaranteed delivery dates . Delays caused by customs authorities, government agencies, shipping carriers, force majeure events, or other circumstances beyond the reasonable control of KREAN JEWELS shall not constitute grounds for order cancellation, refusal of delivery, refund of shipping charges, or any form of compensation. We will, however, work diligently with the shipping carrier to monitor your shipment and assist in resolving any transit-related issues whenever possible. Shipping Availability (ROTW) If your country is not listed in our serviceable destinations, we may still be able to ship your order using our "Rest of the World" delivery service. However, depending on your location, we reserve the right to decline or cancel orders that cannot be delivered safely or reliably. Tracking & Insurance Every order placed with KREAN JEWELS is shipped with comprehensive protection to provide you with complete confidence and peace of mind throughout the delivery process. Each shipment includes: Full Shipment Tracking – Monitor your order in real time from dispatch through final delivery. Comprehensive Shipping Insurance – Every eligible shipment is fully insured against loss or damage while in transit. Secure & Protective Packaging – Your jewelry is professionally packaged using high-quality protective materials to safeguard it throughout shipping. Delivery Confirmation – Confirmation of successful delivery is provided where supported by the selected shipping carrier. Once your order has been dispatched, you will receive a Shipping Confirmation Email containing your tracking information, allowing you to follow your shipment's progress at every stage. If you experience any issues with tracking, delivery, or the condition of your shipment, please contact our Customer Care Team promptly. We will work directly with the shipping carrier to investigate and resolve the matter as quickly as possible. Duties & Taxes (DDP) Selected shipping services, including DHL Express Worldwide and FedEx International Connect Plus® , support Delivered Duty Paid (DDP) for eligible destinations. When DDP is available, import duties and taxes are prepaid before shipment, helping to avoid additional customs charges upon delivery. You'll be able to see during checkout whether your selected shipping method includes DDP (Delivered Duty Paid) before completing your purchase. Shipping Costs Any applicable shipping charges will be calculated automatically at checkout based on the destination, order value, package dimensions, and selected delivery service. All shipping costs will be clearly presented prior to payment, ensuring complete transparency before your order is finalized. From time to time, KREAN JEWELS may extend complimentary shipping on qualifying purchases as part of special promotions or exclusive offers. Eligibility requirements, participating destinations, and promotional terms may vary. All complimentary shipping promotions are offered at the sole discretion of KREAN JEWELS and may be amended or discontinued without prior notice. Order Tracking Once your order has been dispatched, KREAN JEWELS will send you a Shipping Confirmation containing your tracking information via email and, where available, WhatsApp and/or Text Message . This allows you to conveniently monitor your shipment from dispatch through final delivery. Using the tracking number provided, you can access real-time shipment updates directly through the shipping carrier's website and follow your order at every stage of its journey. Please note that tracking information is provided and maintained by the shipping carrier. It may take 24 – 48 hours after dispatch for the first tracking update to appear, and updates may not be available immediately at every transit checkpoint. This is a normal part of the shipping process and does not necessarily indicate a delay. If you do not receive your shipping confirmation or experience any issues accessing your tracking information, please contact our Customer Care Team . For the fastest assistance, include your Order Number and Tracking Number (if available) in your message. Shipping Insurance & Delivery Security At KREAN JEWELS , the safety and security of your jewelry are our highest priorities. Every shipment is professionally packaged and protected with comprehensive transit insurance to safeguard your purchase from the time it leaves our facility until it is successfully delivered. To ensure the secure delivery of valuable jewelry, one or more of the following security measures may be implemented depending on the order value, destination, shipping carrier, or local delivery requirements: Signature Confirmation upon delivery. Government-issued photo identification may be requested by the carrier to verify the recipient's identity. Additional delivery security procedures , including restricted delivery or enhanced verification, where required by the shipping carrier. Customers are responsible for ensuring that the shipping address provided is accurate and that someone is available to receive the shipment when required. Please note that KREAN JEWELS cannot accept responsibility for packages that are: Left unattended at the customer's request. Delivered without a required signature due to customer instructions. Redirected, rerouted, held, or rescheduled at the customer's request after the shipment has been dispatched. Any special delivery instructions provided directly to the shipping carrier are made at the customer's sole risk and may affect the carrier's liability and insurance coverage. Title to and risk of loss for all purchased items transfer to the customer upon confirmed delivery, as evidenced by the carrier's delivery records, tracking information, GPS confirmation, or signature confirmation (where applicable). If you believe your shipment has been lost, damaged, or delivered incorrectly, please contact our Customer Care Team promptly so we can assist you in working with the shipping carrier to investigate the matter. Customs Duties, Taxes & Import Fees International shipments may be subject to customs duties, import taxes, VAT/GST, brokerage fees, customs processing charges, and other government-imposed fees assessed by the destination country's customs authorities. These charges vary by country and are determined solely by the applicable governmental agencies. Unless Delivered Duty Paid (DDP) is expressly selected and included during checkout, all customs duties, taxes, import fees, and related charges are the sole responsibility of the recipient . KREAN JEWELS has no control over these charges and is unable to estimate or guarantee the amount that may be assessed by local customs authorities. Where DDP (Delivered Duty Paid) is available, the applicable duties and taxes will be clearly indicated during checkout before you complete your purchase. If DDP is selected, eligible import duties and taxes are prepaid, helping to avoid additional customs charges upon delivery. Please note that customs inspections, import clearance procedures, documentation reviews, and the payment of applicable duties or taxes may delay delivery. Such delays are beyond the reasonable control of KREAN JEWELS and do not constitute grounds for order cancellation, refusal of delivery, refund of shipping charges, or compensation. If a shipment is refused, abandoned, or returned due to unpaid customs duties, taxes, import fees, or failure to comply with local import regulations, any return shipping costs, customs charges, carrier fees, storage fees, or other related expenses incurred may be deducted from any eligible refund, where permitted under our policies. Incorrect Shipping Information Responsibilities To help ensure a smooth, secure, and timely delivery, customers are responsible for providing accurate, complete, and up-to-date shipping, billing, and contact information during checkout. We strongly recommend reviewing all order details carefully before submitting your purchase. Customers are also responsible for ensuring that someone is available to receive the shipment when required, particularly for deliveries that require a signature or identity verification. KREAN JEWELS shall not be liable for delivery delays, failed deliveries, returned shipments, lost packages, or additional costs resulting from inaccurate, incomplete, or outdated information provided by the customer. This includes, but is not limited to, incorrect recipient names, shipping addresses, postal codes, phone numbers, or email addresses. If a shipment requires an address correction, rerouting, reshipment, storage, customs intervention, or any other carrier-related service due to incorrect customer information, any associated fees, shipping charges, customs costs, taxes, or carrier-imposed surcharges may be the responsibility of the customer . If an order is returned to KREAN JEWELS because of an incorrect address, unsuccessful delivery attempts, refusal of delivery, or failure to provide required information, additional shipping charges may apply before the order can be reshipped. Lost, Delayed, Damaged & Incorrect Shipments At KREAN JEWELS , we are committed to ensuring that every order arrives safely and in perfect condition. If your shipment is delayed, lost, damaged, appears tampered with, contains incorrect items, or has missing contents , please notify our Customer Care Team as soon as possible. reporting allows us to begin an investigation with the shipping carrier and helps preserve eligibility for any applicable claim, replacement, or other resolution. Reporting Requirements Any claim relating to loss, damage, tampering, incorrect items, or missing contents must be reported within 24 hours of the carrier's confirmed delivery . To enable a fair and thorough investigation, all claims must include: A single, continuous, unedited unboxing video clearly showing: The unopened package from all sides. The shipping label. Any visible damage or signs of tampering (if applicable). The complete package opening process. All contents exactly as received. Or, where requested by KREAN JEWELS , participation in a live video inspection with a member of our Customer Care Team. Please note that photographs, screenshots, edited videos, or partial recordings alone are not considered sufficient evidence to support a claim. Claims submitted without the required evidence or outside the 24-hour reporting period may be denied or may not be eligible for replacement, refund, or any other resolution. Investigation & Resolution For eligible claims, KREAN JEWELS will work directly with the shipping carrier and, where applicable, the shipment insurer to investigate the matter on your behalf. Every claim is subject to verification, carrier procedures, insurance terms, and applicable shipping policies. While we are committed to assisting you throughout the claims process, the final determination regarding claim approval, liability, and any compensation is made by the shipping carrier and/or the insurance provider in accordance with their policies and procedures. Contact Us If you have any questions about this Shipping Policy, your order, shipping options, or any of our products and services, our Customer Care Team is here to help. refund-policy: Return, Refund & Exchange Policy Last Updated: June 2026 At KREAN JEWELS, each jewelry creation is crafted with exceptional attention to detail and undergoes comprehensive inspection and quality assurance procedures before leaving our facility. Given the high-value, personalized, and often made-to-order nature of fine jewelry, diamonds, and bespoke creations, all purchases are considered final sale. We kindly ask customers to carefully review all order details, including product specifications, ring sizes, engraving requests, and customization selections before placing an order. Once an order has been confirmed and entered into production or fulfillment, it cannot be canceled, returned, exchanged, or refunded except as required by applicable law or at the sole discretion of KREAN JEWELS. 1. All Sales Are Final All purchases made through KREAN JEWELS are considered final upon order confirmation. Due to the personalized, high-value, and often bespoke nature of fine jewelry, diamonds, and custom-crafted pieces, we do not accept returns, provide refunds, or offer exchanges except where required by applicable law. The following circumstances are specifically excluded from eligibility for return, refund, exchange, or cancellation: • Change of mind or personal preference • Incorrect selections, specifications, or customization requests submitted by the customer • Preference changes following delivery • Ring sizing or fit issues arising from customer-provided measurements • Differences in appearance resulting from normal characteristics of natural or lab-grown diamonds, gemstones, precious metals, or handcrafted production methods • Subsequent promotional offers, discounts, pricing adjustments, or market price fluctuations • Delivery delays attributable to shipping carriers, customs authorities, weather events, or other factors beyond our control Customers are solely responsible for reviewing and confirming all order details prior to purchase. Once an order has been accepted and entered into production or fulfillment, it may not be canceled, modified, returned, exchanged, or refunded except at the sole discretion of KREAN JEWELS or as required by law. 2. Non-Returnable Products The following items are strictly non-returnable, non-refundable, and non-exchangeable: • Lab-Grown Diamonds • Natural Diamonds • Diamond Jewelry • Fine Jewelry and Precious Gemstone Jewelry • Customized or Personalized Jewelry • Engraved Jewelry • Made-to-Order or Bespoke Jewelry • Custom Design and Special Commission Pieces • Special-Order Items Procured Specifically for a Customer • Loose Diamonds and Loose Gemstones • Rings or Jewelry Produced to Customer-Specified Sizes or Measurements • Items Modified, Resized, or Altered at the Customer's Request • Gift Cards, Store Credits, and Promotional Items • Sale, Clearance, Discounted, Promotional, or Final Sale Items • Limited Edition, Exclusive, or One-of-a-Kind Pieces • Any Product Marked as "Final Sale," "Non-Returnable," or "Non-Refundable" at the Time of Purchase • Any Other Product Available Through Our Store That Has Been Customized, Personalized, Specially Ordered, Modified, or Manufactured Specifically for the Customer Due to the unique, high-value, and often made-to-order nature of these products, they are not eligible for return, refund, exchange, or cancellation once an order has been confirmed, except where required by applicable law. 3. Damaged, Defective, or Incorrect Items If you receive an item that is damaged, defective, materially different from the product ordered, or has arrived with signs of shipping damage or tampering, you must notify KREAN JEWELS within 48 hours of confirmed delivery . To submit a claim, please contact: Email: support@kreanjewels.com Your claim must include: • Order number • Detailed description of the issue • Continuous unedited unboxing video showing the item, packaging, shipping label, and any damage or discrepancy • Any additional information reasonably requested by our team to facilitate the investigation Upon receipt of a valid claim, KREAN JEWELS will review the submitted evidence and may conduct additional verification. Following review, and at KREAN JEWELS' sole discretion, we may: • Repair the item • Replace the item with the same or a substantially similar product • Issue a refund if repair or replacement is not reasonably available All claims are subject to inspection, verification, and approval. Claims submitted more than 48 hours after delivery , or claims lacking sufficient supporting documentation, may be denied and may not be eligible for repair, replacement, refund, or other resolution. 4. Order Cancellation Cancellation requests may be accepted only if submitted before an order enters production, customization, fulfillment, or shipment. Due to the handcrafted and often made-to-order nature of our jewelry, production may begin shortly after an order is confirmed. Once an order has entered production, customization, quality assurance, packaging, or shipping, it becomes final and cannot be canceled, modified, returned, or refunded. This includes, but is not limited to, custom-designed pieces, personalized jewelry, engraved items, made-to-order creations, and special-order products. KREAN JEWELS reserves the right to determine, at its sole discretion, whether an order remains eligible for cancellation at the time a request is received. 5. Refused Deliveries Refusal of delivery does not constitute a valid basis for cancellation, return, refund, chargeback, or exchange. Customers who refuse delivery of an order remain responsible for all costs associated with the shipment. In the event that a shipment is refused, returned, or undeliverable due to customer action or inaction, KREAN JEWELS reserves the right to deduct any applicable expenses from any approved reimbursement related to a verified shipping error, including but not limited to: • Return shipping charges • Customs duties, import taxes, and brokerage fees • Carrier handling, storage, or rerouting fees • Insurance costs • Payment processing fees where permitted by law • Any other expenses incurred as a result of the refused or returned shipment For custom-made, personalized, engraved, made-to-order, special-order, and final-sale items, refused deliveries will not create any entitlement to a refund, replacement, or store credit unless otherwise required by applicable law. 6. Payment Disputes & Chargebacks At KREAN JEWELS, customer satisfaction is our priority. We encourage customers to contact our support team directly before initiating a chargeback or payment dispute, as many concerns can be resolved efficiently through our customer service process. Where a chargeback or dispute is initiated, KREAN JEWELS reserves the right to provide comprehensive supporting documentation to the relevant payment processor, financial institution, card issuer, or dispute resolution authority. Such documentation may include order records, payment verification, shipment tracking information, delivery confirmations, customer correspondence, customization approvals, quality-control records, and other evidence demonstrating fulfillment of the transaction. KREAN JEWELS actively contests fraudulent, abusive, or otherwise invalid chargebacks and reserves all rights and remedies available under applicable law. 7. Contact Us If you have any questions regarding this Policy, your order, or our products and services, our Customer Care Team will be happy to assist you. privacy-policy: Last updated: July 11, 2026 KREAN JEWELS operates this store and website, including all related information, content, features, tools, products and services, in order to provide you, the customer, with a curated shopping experience (the "Services"). This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, and disclose your personal information when you visit, use, or make a purchase or other transaction using the Services or otherwise communicate with us. If there is a conflict between our Terms of Service and this Privacy Policy, this Privacy Policy controls with respect to the collection, processing, and disclosure of your personal information. Please read this Privacy Policy carefully. By using and accessing any of the Services, you acknowledge that you have read this Privacy Policy and understand the collection, use, and disclosure of your information as described in this Privacy Policy. Personal Information We Collect or Process When we use the term "personal information," we are referring to information that identifies or can reasonably be linked to you or another person. Personal information does not include information that is collected anonymously or that has been de-identified, so that it cannot identify or be reasonably linked to you. We may collect or process the following categories of personal information, including inferences drawn from this personal information, depending on how you interact with the Services, where you live, and as permitted or required by applicable law: Contact details including your name, address, billing address, shipping address, phone number, and email address. Financial information including credit card, debit card, and financial account numbers, payment card information, financial account information, transaction details, form of payment, payment confirmation and other payment details. Account information including your username, password, security questions, preferences and settings. Transaction information including the items you view, put in your cart, add to your wishlist, or purchase, return, exchange or cancel and your past transactions. Communications with us including the information you include in communications with us, for example, when sending a customer support inquiry. Device information including information about your device, browser, or network connection, your IP address, and other unique identifiers. Usage information including information regarding your interaction with the Services, including how and when you interact with or navigate the Services. Personal Information Sources We may collect personal information from the following sources: Directly from you including when you create an account, visit or use the Services, communicate with us, or otherwise provide us with your personal information; Automatically through the Services including from your device when you use our products or services or visit our websites, and through the use of cookies and similar technologies; From our service providers including when we engage them to enable certain technology and when they collect or process your personal information on our behalf; From our partners or other third parties. We use your personal information to provide you with the Services, including to perform our contract with you, to process your payments, to fulfill your orders, to remember your preferences and items you are interested in, to send notifications to you related to your account, to process purchases, returns, exchanges or other transactions, to create, maintain and otherwise manage your account, to arrange for shipping, to facilitate any returns and exchanges, to enable you to post reviews, and to create a customized shopping experience for you, such as recommending products related to your purchases. This may include using your personal information to better tailor and improve the Services. Marketing and Advertising. We use your personal information for marketing and promotional purposes, such as to send marketing, advertising and promotional communications by email, text message or postal mail, and to show you online advertisements for products or services on the Services or other websites, including based on items you previously have purchased or added to your cart and other activity on the Services. Security and Fraud Prevention. We use your personal information to authenticate your account, to provide a secure payment and shopping experience, detect, investigate or take action regarding possible fraudulent, illegal, unsafe, or malicious activity, protect public safety, and to secure our services. If you choose to use the Services and register an account, you are responsible for keeping your account credentials safe. We highly recommend that you do not share your username, password or other access details with anyone else. Communicating with You. We use your personal information to provide you with customer support, to be responsive to you, to provide effective services to you and to maintain our business relationship with you. Legal Reasons. We use your personal information to comply with applicable law or respond to valid legal process, including requests from law enforcement or government agencies, to investigate or participate in civil discovery, potential or actual litigation, or other adversarial legal proceedings, and to enforce or investigate potential violations of our terms or policies. How We Disclose Personal Information In certain circumstances, we may disclose your personal information to third parties for legitimate purposes subject to this Privacy Policy. Such circumstances may include: With Shopify, vendors and other third parties who perform services on our behalf (e.g. IT management, payment processing, data analytics, customer support, cloud storage, fulfillment and shipping). With business and marketing partners to provide marketing services and advertise to you. For example, we use Shopify to support personalized advertising with third-party services based on your online activity with different merchants and websites. Our business and marketing partners will use your information in accordance with their own privacy notices. Depending on where you reside, you may have a right to direct us not to share information about you to show you targeted advertisements and marketing based on your online activity with different merchants and websites.
